summary.name: RoomLab.app
summary.one_liner: RoomLab.app is an AI tool that stages, restyles, declutters and adds walkthrough video effects to photos of rooms and properties.
use_cases: Staging empty property listings with virtual furniture
Decluttering personal items from listing photos
Previewing renovation or restyle options before building
Creating walkthrough videos showing a finished home
Testing whether a piece of furniture fits a room
summary.what_it_does: RoomLab.app takes an uploaded photo of a room, exterior, or 3D model and generates an edited version using a chosen mode. Modes described on the page include virtual staging of empty rooms, replacing furniture and materials (including using a reference image), decluttering while keeping furniture and lighting, and restyling. A House Tour feature adds a finished-look picture to a walkthrough video of a home under construction. Output is provided as downloadable images and videos, with paid plans removing watermarks.
notable: Virtual staging, decluttering, material swapping and video walkthrough effects in one tool
Credit-based system with a one-time 150-credit pack and monthly/yearly subscription tiers
House Tour video feature for properties still under construction
caveats: Paid credits required to generate; the one-time Personal pack excludes House Tour
Free download without watermark requires a paid plan
